listen_addr.description: IP address the VPN server will bind to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces, or a specific IP)

listen_port.description: UDP port the VPN server will listen on

private_key_path.description: Absolute path to the server’s private key file (generated with `quicktun-keygen`)

peers.description: List of trusted peers (clients or other servers) allowed to connect

name.description: Human-readable name for the peer (used only in comments)

public_key.description: Base64-encoded public key of the peer (required)

allowed_ips.description: List of IP ranges (CIDR) the peer is allowed to use (e.g., ['10.10.0.2/32'])

preshared_key.description: Optional base64-encoded preshared key for extra encryption (for post-quantum security)

log_syslog.description: Whether to send logs to the system syslog daemon

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent peer connections allowed

pidfile_path.description: Path to write the process PID file

keepalive_enabled.description: Enable periodic keepalive messages to detect dead peers

keepalive_interval.description: Seconds between keepalive packets (if enabled); typical value: 25
